verse.name: v1a
verse.lines:
God is able
He will never fail
He is almighty God

verse.name: v1b
verse.lines:
Greater than all we seek
Greater than all we ask
He has done great things

verse.name: c1a
verse.lines:
Lifted up, He defeated the grave
Raised to life, our God is able

verse.name: c1b
verse.lines:
In His name, we overcome
For the Lord, our God is able

verse.name: v2a
verse.lines:
God is with us
God is on our side
He will make a way

verse.name: v2b
verse.lines:
Far above all we know
Far above all we hope
He has done great things

verse.name: b1a
verse.lines:
God is with us
He will go before

verse.name: b1b
verse.lines:
He will never leave us
He will never leave us

verse.name: b1c
verse.lines:
God is for us
He has open arms

verse.name: b1d
verse.lines:
He will never fail us
He will never fail us
